description: SV big-vendor evidence: what the four largest untested supply lines in the whole-market sizing (Google grounding, Anthropic's and OpenAI's web search tools, Microsoft Grounding with Bing) can be pinned to from public sources. Six facets per vendor: volume, revenue, the denominator the sizing uses, price and terms, supply, and named adoption.
frozen: 2026-09-27, before the first Stage C call

items.question: How many grounded queries does Google's Grounding with Google Search serve through the Gemini API and Vertex AI (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform)? Find any disclosed or credibly reported usage figure or growth rate from 2025 or 2026.
